text:
julia_ae: Quick — enterprise prospect (RegBank) wants BYOK/HSM answers for procurement: confirmation keys never leave HSM, rotation policy, and a ballpark price delta. Meeting tomorrow. Can we get short bullets + one pager?

sam_security: Yes. We support BYOK via HSM proxy or cloud-KMS bindings. We never export private key material from customer HSM; we perform wrapping/unwrapping calls only. We can provide a redacted attestation showing vendor & FIPS status.

kai_fieldeng: For perf: single-region HSM proxy added ~15-22ms median in our staging smoke. Multi-region failover adds ~30-60ms. Will produce a one-page perf + network checklist.

omar_sre: Network must allow outbound TLS 443 to our proxy CIDRs; if they want private-link/peering, that’s additional setup. Will post IPs and checklist by 2pm PT.

lena_legal: I'll draft two short contract snippets: (1) no-escrow default + customer key ownership, (2) optional escrow addendum with fees/SLA. Also proof-of-destruction language on termination.

julia_ae: Pricing ask: give a ballpark premium vs hosted for ~100k tokens/day. Don’t need exacts, just ranges.

kai_fieldeng: Ballpark: expect a ~8-18% per-token processing premium for BYOK/HSM proxy and a one-time onboarding fee ($1.5k-$3k typical). Dedicated reserved capacity separate.

sam_security: Rotation: customers control rotation. Default recommended cadence 30-90 days; we support on-demand rotation APIs and emergency rewrap. We can shorten window in SOW.

deploy-bot: staging/byok-proxy deployed ✅ https://staging.redwood.ai/ops/instances/byok-99 (creds in secure channel)

julia_ae: Great — deliverables: redacted attestation + 2-sentence summary (sam), 1-page perf/network checklist (kai/omar), 2 contract snippets (lena), pricing ranges (kai + finance). Can everyone drop their pieces by EOD?

kai_fieldeng: Will post perf one-pager by 5pm PT.

omar_sre: IP list + terraform snippet by 3:30pm PT.

sam_security: Attestation draft in Drive by 5pm PT.

lena_legal: Clauses by 5pm PT.

julia_ae: Thanks team — I’ll compile and send to procurement after your drops. :thumbsup:
